name.ja: BB戦士254 蒼天丸＆紅天丸（ソウテンマル＆コウテンマル）

description.ja: コミックボンボンで好評連載中の「SD頑駄無　武者○伝3」に登場する武侍丸の仲間になる宮廷料理人兄弟武者「蒼天丸&紅天丸」のプラモデル。2体の武者がセットで登場です。それぞれ「軽装形態」から「武者形態」への鎧の装着を再現できます。さらに「麒麟形態」への変形合体も可能です。各種調理器具を武装として装備可能です。
description.en: A plastic model of the court chef brother warriors "Sotenmaru and Benitenmaru " who become Takemuramaru's companions that appear in " SD Gundam u Musha○den 3 " currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon. Two warriors appear as a set. You can reproduce the wearing of armor from " light armor form " to " warrior form ". Furthermore, it is possible to transform and combine into " Kirin form". Can be equipped with various cooking utensils as weapons.
